command: set -eu; echo '=== GIT STATE ==='; git -C /Users/michal/local-agent status --short; echo HEAD=$(git -C /Users/michal/local-agent rev-parse HEAD); echo ORIGIN_MAIN_LOCAL=$(git -C /Users/michal/local-agent rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null || true); echo ORIGIN_MAIN_REMOTE=$(git -C /Users/michal/local-agent ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}'); echo '=== REJECTED UPDATE ==='; find "$HOME/Library/Application Support/local-agent" -maxdepth 4 -name 'rejected-self-update.json' -print -exec cat {} \; 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== SELF UPDATE LOG ==='; grep -i 'self-update' "$HOME/Library/Logs/local-agent.log" | tail -n 80 || true; echo '=== ERROR LOG ==='; tail -n 80 "$HOME/Library/Logs/local-agent-error.log" || true
